scientific_integrity: A self-contained exact analytic theorem with a self-review; independent validation has not been performed. Numerical and finite rational tests check but do not establish the universal proof. Historical originality is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Orthogonal three-dimensional flat tori with independent normalized Haar sampling only; skew tori and arbitrary distributions are excluded.
Moment inversion describes exact population even-distance moments; statistical sampling-error bounds are not supplied.
The relevant 1978 Silverman article could be inspected at abstract level only; no full-text absence claim is made.
The zero-volume boundary is a degeneration and is excluded from the set of tori.
title: A sharp volume-identifiability transition from three intrinsic distance moments of rectangular flat three-tori
